intent: Closed with its premise corrected. The plan recorded that LangGraph and OpenHands had no pack-local research record, two of the seven agentic systems the v2 scope named. Checked against the tree, both are covered and cited by packs/agentic-development at the same depth as the other five: EV-0001 for the OpenHands SDK paper, EV-0048 for LangGraph and EV-0079 for its interrupt semantics, appearing in PACK.md binding requirements, CHECKS.md, the exemplar and the topology guide. What they lacked was a pack-local FRAG record, which is provenance about which sweep found a source rather than a gap in coverage, and manufacturing records to make that symmetry would have added weight without adding evidence. One genuinely new source was read and added instead: the LangGraph durable-execution documentation at EV-0449, which establishes that durability is a property of the checkpointer and that the default in-memory savers lose every snapshot on restart. It is recorded against EV-0047, which puts the same mechanism at the boundary rather than in the worker; the pack now carries the disagreement rather than resolving it.
